name: records
leases
sql:
-- The lease table (D04 R[0]): one row per key, the fencing token monotonic per row. Expiry is decided by the
-- database clock; an expired or released row is taken over in place (UPDATE ... WHERE expires_at <= now() OR
-- released_at IS NOT NULL), never deleted, so the token never repeats for a key.
CREATE TABLE leases (
  key text PRIMARY KEY CHECK (key ~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9:._/-]{0,199}$'),
  lease_id text NOT NULL CHECK (lease_id ~ '^lse_[0-9a-z]{26}$'),
  run_id text NOT NULL CHECK (run_id ~ '^run_[0-9a-z]{26}$'),
  user_id text NOT NULL CHECK (user_id ~ '^usr_[0-9a-z]{26}$'),
  token bigint NOT NULL CHECK (token >= 1),
  acquired_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  expires_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  released_at timestamptz
);
CREATE INDEX leases_prefix ON leases (key);

name: trace_spans
sql:
CREATE TABLE public.trace_spans(
  trace_id pg_catalog.text NOT NULL CHECK(trace_id ~ '^[0-9a-f]{32}$'),
  span_id pg_catalog.text NOT NULL CHECK(span_id ~ '^[0-9a-f]{16}$'),
  parent_span_id pg_catalog.text CHECK(parent_span_id ~ '^[0-9a-f]{16}$'),
  is_root pg_catalog.bool NOT NULL,
  name pg_catalog.text NOT NULL,
  type pg_catalog.text NOT NULL,
  started_at pg_catalog.timestamptz NOT NULL,
  ended_at pg_catalog.timestamptz NOT NULL,
  level pg_catalog.text NOT NULL,
  status_message pg_catalog.text CHECK(pg_catalog.char_length(status_message)<=1000),
  origin pg_catalog.text NOT NULL,
  user_id pg_catalog.text,
  session_id pg_catalog.text,
  run_id pg_catalog.text,
  client_name pg_catalog.text,
  client_version pg_catalog.text,
  release pg_catalog.text,
  environment pg_catalog.text,
  usage pg_catalog.jsonb NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY(trace_id,span_id)
);
CREATE INDEX trace_spans_started ON public.trace_spans (started_at);
CREATE INDEX trace_spans_roots ON public.trace_spans (started_at DESC) WHERE is_root;
CREATE INDEX trace_spans_root_names ON public.trace_spans (name,started_at DESC) WHERE is_root;
CREATE INDEX trace_spans_root_users ON public.trace_spans (user_id,started_at DESC) WHERE is_root;

sql:
CREATE TABLE public.resource_samples(
 seq pg_catalog.int8 GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
 sampled_at pg_catalog.timestamptz NOT NULL,
 boot pg_catalog.text NOT NULL,
 interval_ms pg_catalog.int4,
 process_cpu_ratio pg_catalog.float8,
 event_loop_utilization pg_catalog.float8,
 event_loop_delay_p50_ms pg_catalog.float8,
 event_loop_delay_p99_ms pg_catalog.float8,
 event_loop_delay_max_ms pg_catalog.float8,
 heap_used_bytes pg_catalog.int8,
 heap_limit_bytes pg_catalog.int8,
 rss_bytes pg_catalog.int8,
 external_bytes pg_catalog.int8,
 array_buffers_bytes pg_catalog.int8,
 gc_pause_ms pg_catalog.float8,
 sandbox_running pg_catalog.int4,
 sandbox_limit pg_catalog.int4,
 sandbox_waiting pg_catalog.int4,
 sandbox_timeouts pg_catalog.int8,
 sandbox_queue_full pg_catalog.int8,
 pool_limit pg_catalog.int4,
 pool_total pg_catalog.int4,
 pool_idle pg_catalog.int4,
 pool_waiting pg_catalog.int4,
 pool_connection_failures pg_catalog.int8,
 pg_active_connections pg_catalog.int4,
 pg_cache_hit_ratio pg_catalog.float8,
 pg_waiting_locks pg_catalog.int4,
 pg_deadlocks pg_catalog.int8,
 data_free_bytes pg_catalog.int8,
 io_wait_ratio pg_catalog.float8,
 mcp_sessions pg_catalog.int4,
 mcp_sessions_by_client pg_catalog.jsonb,
 console_streams pg_catalog.int4,
 requests_in_flight pg_catalog.int4,
 failed_reads pg_catalog.text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
 dropped_samples pg_catalog.int4 NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
);
CREATE INDEX resource_samples_sampled_at ON public.resource_samples(sampled_at);
CREATE INDEX resource_samples_boot ON public.resource_samples(boot,sampled_at);
CREATE TABLE public.process_events(
 seq pg_catalog.int8 GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
 at pg_catalog.timestamptz NOT NULL,
 kind pg_catalog.text NOT NULL CHECK(kind ~ '^[a-z][a-z_]{0,39}$'),
 boot pg_catalog.text,
 pid pg_catalog.int4,
 release pg_catalog.text,
 node_version pg_catalog.text,
 heap_limit_bytes pg_catalog.int8,
 uptime_ms pg_catalog.int8,
 last_seen_at pg_catalog.timestamptz,
 requests pg_catalog.jsonb,
 requests_omitted pg_catalog.int4 NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 reports pg_catalog.jsonb
);
CREATE INDEX process_events_at ON public.process_events(at);
-- One start and one ending per process, whoever detects it: two starts cannot both report the same crash.
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX process_events_start ON public.process_events(boot) WHERE kind='start';
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX process_events_end ON public.process_events(boot) WHERE kind<>'start';

name: run_started_index
sql:
INSERT INTO public.record_index(key,value,digest,record_seq)
 SELECT 'runs.started',(s.b->>'started_at')||' '||(s.b->>'run'),s.digest,s.seq
 FROM (SELECT r.digest,r.seq,pg_catalog.replace(r.body,pg_catalog.chr(92)||'u0000',pg_catalog.chr(92)||'uFFFD')::pg_catalog.json AS b FROM public.hub_read_records() r WHERE r.kind='run') s
 WHERE s.b->>'started_at' ~ '^[0-9T:.Z-]+$' AND s.b->>'run' ~ '^[0-9a-z_]+$'
 ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

name: feeding_node_index
sql:
INSERT INTO public.record_index(key,value,digest,record_seq)
 SELECT DISTINCT 'knowledge.feeding.node',n.value,f.digest,f.seq
 FROM (SELECT r.digest,r.seq,p.value AS product,COALESCE(j.b#>'{statement,data,feeding}',j.b#>'{statement,data}') AS body
   FROM public.record_index p JOIN public.hub_read_records() r ON r.digest=p.digest
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT pg_catalog.replace(r.body,pg_catalog.chr(92)||'u0000',pg_catalog.chr(92)||'uFFFD')::pg_catalog.jsonb AS b) j
   WHERE p.key='knowledge.feeding.product' AND r.kind='claim') f
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
   WITH places AS (
     SELECT f.body->>'path' AS path WHERE pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(f.body->'path')='string'
     UNION SELECT '/' WHERE f.body->'path' IS NULL OR pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(f.body->'path')='null'
     UNION SELECT c->>'path' FROM pg_catalog.jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(f.body->'commands')='array' THEN f.body->'commands' ELSE '[]'::pg_catalog.jsonb END) c
       WHERE pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(c)='object' AND pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(c->'path')='string')
   SELECT f.product||':'||(f.body->>'root')||':'||CASE WHEN (SELECT pg_catalog.count(*) FROM places)>64 THEN '*'
     ELSE pg_catalog.encode(pg_catalog.sha256(pg_catalog.convert_to(places.path,'UTF8')),'hex') END AS value FROM places) n
 WHERE pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(f.body)='object' AND f.body->>'root' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
 ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

name: request_listing_indexes
sql:
INSERT INTO public.record_index(key,value,digest,record_seq)
 SELECT 'runs.request.settled',s.value,s.digest,s.record_seq
 FROM (SELECT i.value,i.digest,i.record_seq,pg_catalog.replace(r.body,pg_catalog.chr(92)||'u0000',pg_catalog.chr(92)||'uFFFD')::pg_catalog.json AS b
   FROM public.record_index i JOIN public.hub_read_records() r ON r.digest=i.digest WHERE i.key='runs.request.answer' AND r.kind='action') s
 WHERE pg_catalog.json_typeof(s.b->'detail'->'answer')='string'
 ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
INSERT INTO public.record_index(key,value,digest,record_seq)
 SELECT 'runs.request.plain',COALESCE(s.b->>'run',s.b->>'pack_digest'),s.digest,s.seq
 FROM (SELECT r.digest,r.seq,pg_catalog.replace(r.body,pg_catalog.chr(92)||'u0000',pg_catalog.chr(92)||'uFFFD')::pg_catalog.json AS b
   FROM public.hub_read_records() r WHERE r.kind='request') s
 WHERE (s.b->'declaration' IS NULL OR pg_catalog.json_typeof(s.b->'declaration')='null') AND COALESCE(s.b->>'run',s.b->>'pack_digest') ~ '^[0-9a-z_]{1,128}$'
 ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
